This four-verse unit shows cross-psalm texture with Ps 115's idol polemic (115:4-115:8): a word-by-word byte comparison of both psalms' own text (verse_map_oshb.json) finds oshb:Ps.135.16 matching oshb:Ps.115.5 and oshb:Ps.135.18 matching oshb:Ps.115.8 letter-for-letter, while 135:15's construct chain with the article (עֲצַבֵּ֣י הַ֭גּוֹיִם) differs from 115:4's suffixed plural (oshb:Ps.115.4: עֲֽ֭צַבֵּיהֶם), and 135:17's own clause (oshb:Ps.135.17: אָזְנַ֣יִם לָ֭הֶם וְלֹ֣א יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ) is longer than 115:6 alone on all 3 measures taken (skeleton words, consonants, codepoints), running shorter only against 115:6-115:7 combined, and substitutes a different verb root (יַאֲזִ֑ינוּ for oshb:Ps.115.6's יִשְׁמָ֑עוּ) inside the clause the two verses share. It is discussed here as a recognizable, recurring cross-psalm texture, not merged with Ps 115's own rows.
